stories.title: Federal judge orders release of man detained by ICE in Maine
stories.summary: A federal judge ruled that immigration officials unlawfully detained an Ecuadorian man in Maine, ordering his release and placing limits on his future detention.

stories.title: Firefighters battle house fire in South Berwick Saturday afternoon
stories.summary: Crews from New Hampshire were called to assist as firefighters worked to bring the blaze under control Saturday afternoon.

stories.title: NEWS CENTER Maine Weather Forecast
stories.summary: Sunny Saturday, clouds increase Sunday ahead of rain Sunday night

stories.title: Maine wrongful death lawsuit moves forward after gun parts seller settles
stories.summary: A Maine family's wrongful death lawsuit against an online ammunition retailer is moving forward after a second company named in the case reached a settlement.

stories.title: Crews battle forest fire in Woodstock, now mostly contained
stories.summary: CMP's outage map showed 37 people without power in the area of Mann Road, near Bucks Ridge, a hiking area, and North Pond.

stories.title: Two families come together to remember Waldoboro teen killed in crash
stories.summary: A Waldoboro woman organized a vigil for 17-year-old Brody Sawyer, killed in a hit-and-run involving her uncle. She says she warned authorities about his driving.

stories.title: Maine military surplus store sees increased demand for emergency supplies
stories.summary: A Scarborough military surplus store says demand for emergency supplies is rising as recent outages and cyber disruptions prompt more people to prepare.

stories.title: Nurses, community detail a decline in services at CMMC during DHHS public hearing
stories.summary: Hospital leadership denies that quality of care and workplace satisfaction has diminished since a California-based nonprofit acquired the CMMC earlier this year.

stories.title: Gardiner church to close for the winter after discovering a $2 million need in repairs
stories.summary: Immediate repairs would cost approximately $80,000, parish leaders say. They hope to have a better understanding of their options by the spring.

stories.title: Newport teacher awarded for innovative use of technology in the classroom
stories.summary: Students say his teaching style is making a real impact.

stories.title: Inside the Hampden facility bringing recycling back to greater Bangor
stories.summary: Recycling resumes after a six-year hiatus, offering a single-stream system to divert waste from landfills.

stories.title: Maine health experts raise concerns over loss of U.S. measles elimination status
stories.summary: Doctors say Mainers should check their vaccination records as measles continues to spread nationwide.
